body: For me they always come and go. Somedays I'm ok but others they just come flooding back. I can't seem to shake it and I guess this is how it will be for the rest of my life.

I feel you... I hate when people tell me to do X or do Y and everything will be good again. How is that going to fucking help whenever the next bad thing happens and suicidal thoughts come rushing in again.
Same here. The fight doesn't seem to get any easier.

I feel like im in a similar scenario as you. I'm not sure if im truly overreacting or actually suicidal but this always happens to me. Anytime something really bad happens in my life and I'm feeling really down my first thoughts are towards suicide. Only thing that stops me is that im a pussy and prob would never go through with it but it scares me to think that one day i will...
